Challenge_VC_PileUp_desc: The first night. You fled Muldraugh in a thunderstorm and drove into the back of a traffic jam on the highway. It is late, your leg is broken, and the dead are closing in. <LINE> <LINE> Whatever you packed is still in the trunk. Nobody is coming.
Challenge_VC_Nomad_desc: A year after it all ended, in a December blizzard, on a road at the far south-west edge of the map. Somewhere north-east is the tallest building in Louisville. Get to the top floor. <LINE> <LINE> No car will start. You have what you carry, a paper map with the tower circled, and one life.
Challenge_VC_LastBroadcast_desc: Day fourteen. The radio has been static for a week; LBMW, Kentucky Radio, was the first station to go quiet. Its reporter's studio is a few hundred metres east of the house you are hiding in. <LINE> <LINE> Get there, clear it, get the power on, and put LBMW back on the air at six o'clock. Every evening. Thirty shows, never more than two days apart. One life.
